rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1993). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1993).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S in 2000 as 'Twist'.
rows.Class: Climber, Patio Rose, Cl.. (Series: Courtyard ® Collection)
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, white streaks. Moderate fragrance. 30 to 39 petals. Average diameter 2.5". Medium, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, climbing. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4'11" to 6'7" (150 to 200cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for pillar.
